summary: UGI Corp's indirect subsidiaries AmeriGas Partners and AmeriGas Finance Corp. filed an 8-K disclosing a private offering of $500M senior notes due 2031 and tender offers for any/all outstanding 5.750% Senior Notes due 2027 and up to $175M of 9.375% Senior Notes due 2028. The tender offers are conditional on successful financing, an equity contribution from parent UGI International, and cash on hand to fund purchases, redeem remaining 2027 notes, repay a $150M intercompany loan, and pay fees. No premium or price per share is specified as these are debt instruments. Watch for completion of the financing condition and the conditional redemption notice for untendered 2027 notes; risk-arb focuses on noteholder participation and market conditions.
